# Cite This For Me

> A free online citation generator supporting 1000+ citation styles (APA, MLA, Harvard, Chicago, and more) for students and academics to create accurate bibliographies and references.

Cite This For Me is a comprehensive citation tool that helps students and researchers format their sources correctly across multiple academic citation styles. The platform provides both automated citation generation and detailed guides for proper reference formatting.

## Citation Generators

- [Citation Machine: Accurate & Easy-to-Use](https://www.citethisforme.com/guides): Main citation generator supporting 1000+ styles including APA, MLA, Harvard, and Chicago
- [APA Citation Generator & Format](https://www.citethisforme.com/us/citation-generator/apa): APA citation generator for accurate citations in APA format
- [MLA Format Citation Generator](https://www.citethisforme.com/us/citation-generator/mla): MLA format citation generator for accurate MLA style citations
- [Harvard Referencing Generator & Guide](https://www.citethisforme.com/uk/referencing-generator/harvard): Harvard referencing generator and guide for accurate source citations
- [Chicago Style Citation Generator & Guide](https://www.citethisforme.com/us/citation-generator/chicago): Chicago style citation generator and guide for source formatting
